title: The wrong train
text:
Last Friday, Piotr had an important job interview in Poznań. He got up very early, at five o'clock, and took a taxi to the station. He was tired, so he bought a big coffee and got on the train on platform 3. He sat down by the window and soon he fell asleep.

When he woke up, he looked out of the window. Something was wrong. He could see the sea! He asked the woman next to him, "Excuse me, where are we?" She smiled. "We're near Gdańsk." Piotr couldn't believe it. He was on the wrong train!

He got off at the next station and called the company. He explained everything and said sorry. The manager, Mrs Nowak, laughed. "Don't worry," she said. "We can do the interview online." So at eleven o'clock Piotr sat in a small café in Gdynia, opened his laptop and did his interview there.

Two days later, Mrs Nowak called him again. Piotr got the job! Now he always checks the platform twice.
